meta.login: Sign in to my FOVE account

login.title: My FOVE account
login.subtitle: Find all your FOVE loyalty cards, on any phone.
login.noPassword: No password: we send you a 6-digit code.
login.codeSent: If {email} is correct, a 6-digit code has just been sent to it. It is valid for 10 minutes.
login.checkSpam: Nothing received? Check your spam folder.
login.deleted: Your FOVE account has been deleted.

home.title: My cards
home.welcomeBody: Enter your name so businesses recognise you. Your phone number will be suggested when you join a programme.
home.cardsEmpty: Cards created with your FOVE account will appear here, each in its business's colours.
home.phoneHint: Pre-filled when you join a programme. It is never used to sign in.
home.emailHint: This is the address you sign in with. It can't be changed yet.
home.dangerBody: Your cards stay with each business, with your points, and their links keep working. They are simply no longer grouped in your account.
home.deleteConsequence: Your account is permanently deleted and you are signed out. Your cards and points stay with each business. To erase your data at a business, contact that business.
home.dataBody: Download a file with all your FOVE account data: profile, signed-in devices, linked cards and security history.
home.inactivity: If you neither sign in nor use one of your cards at a till for 3 years, your account is deleted, after a warning email 30 days before. Your cards stay with the businesses.
home.confirmBody: To open “My cards”, confirm {email} with the code we send you.
home.linkableBody: Some businesses have registered a card with your email {email}. Add them to your account to find them here.
home.cardsEmptyHint: Scan the QR code of a FOVE partner business to create your first card.
home.installDescription: Open all your FOVE cards in one tap from your home screen.
home.installDone: “My cards” opens in one tap, like an app.

banner.title: Find your cards anywhere
banner.body: Confirm your email ({email}) to find your FOVE cards on any phone.
banner.done: Email confirmed: your cards are in “My cards”.

google.failed: Signing in with Google didn't work. Try again, or get a code by email.
google.unavailable: Signing in with Google isn't available right now: get a code by email.

legal.draft: Draft under legal review: this text may still change.
legal.frenchOnly: This document is currently available in French only.
legal.continue: By continuing, you accept the FOVE account <terms>terms of use</terms> and <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
legal.create: By creating your card, you also create your FOVE account and accept its <terms>terms of use</terms> and <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
